text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah (Perancangan)

Wilayah Persekutuan (Fi bagi Pembelian Draf Pelan Struktur) 2020.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 18 Februari 2020.

Fi

2. Fi bagi pembelian salinan draf Pelan Struktur Kuala Lumpur 2040 hendaklah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Kaedah 2]

Salinan Fi satu salinan

(RM)

(a) bahasa kebangsaan

 (i) salinan cetak 150.00

 (ii) bentuk elektronik 100.00

(b) bahasa Inggeris

 (i) salinan cetak 150.00

 (ii) bentuk elektronik 100.00

Dibuat 14 Februari 2020

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/11/2003 JLD.1; PN(PU2)396/VII]

DATO' NOR HISHAM BIN A DAHLAN

Datuk Bandar Kuala Lumpur

Diluluskan 14 Februari 2020

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/11/2003 JLD.1; PN(PU2)396/VII]

HAJI KHALID BIN ABD. SAMAD

Menteri Wilayah Persekutuan

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF DRAFT STRUCTURE

PLAN) RULES 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 7 and paragraph 64(2)(j)

of the Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner of the City of

Kuala Lumpur, with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning)

(Fee for Purchase of Draft Structure Plan) Rules 2020.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 18 February 2020.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the draft Kuala Lumpur Structure Plan 2040

shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

Copy Fee per copy

(RM)

(a) national language

 (i) hard copy 150.00

 (ii) electronic form 100.00

(b) English language

 (i) hard copy 150.00

 (ii) electronic form 100.00

Made 14 February 2020

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/11/2003 JLD.1; PN(PU2)396/VII]

Approved 14 February 2020

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/11/2003 JLD.1; PN(PU2)396/VII]

DATO' NOR HISHAM BIN A DAHLAN

Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur

HAJI KHALID BIN ABD. SAMAD

Minister of Federal Territory
